text:
emma: Opening a concise thread for the release notes + changelog item that covers: CLI plugin flag changes, a tiny migration how-to for the CLI and SDK snippets, plus an anchor sweep for a few broken internal links. keeping this short.
raj: noted. what's the CLI change?
emma: the CLI plugin `redwood-cli` replaces `--model` with `--model-alias` and changes `--stream-embeddings` to `--embeddings-stream`. examples that call `redwood run --model abc` will break. i'll draft migrate-cli.md with examples and a one-liner top summary.
olga: good catch. i'll grep for `--model ` and `--stream-embeddings` in docs and open PRs for fixes. i found ~9 hits across examples and runbooks.
docs-bot: PR #4010 opened by olga — CLI example flag updates in docs/cli and runbooks.
emma: sample migration snippet to include in migrate-cli.md:
```bash
# old
redwood run --model my-recipe -i input.json

# new
redwood run --model-alias my-recipe -i input.json
# or use explicit embeddings flag
redwood run --model-alias my-recipe --embeddings-stream true -i input.json
```
raj: for SDK snippets, please also standardize the comment header to indicate SDK versions: Python examples -> v0.14, JS examples -> v1.2, Go -> v0.6. helps support.
emma: agreed. i'll add a short note at the top of relnotes: "Examples reflect latest SDKs: Python v0.14, JS v1.2, Go v0.6".
mike: ops asked for an explicit rollback alias command different from earlier threads — use alias `previous-release-2026-02` and add a caution about traffic switching. snippet: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/aliases/switch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"alias":"previous-release-2026-02"}'
```
olga: found three broken anchors in docs/cli/plugins.md after the last TOC refactor; i'll patch them in the PR. also spotted two pages with hardcoded api_key strings — will scrub.
docs-bot: PR #4011 opened by olga — anchor fixes + key scrub.
raj: small Windows-specific known issue to include: CLI path flags with unquoted backslashes can be mishandled (example: `-i C:\data\input.json`), causing a JSON parse error in the CLI launcher on Windows 10. workaround: wrap paths in quotes or use forward slashes `C:/data/input.json`. internal ticket #539.
emma: add that under "Known issues" with the exact workaround text. marketing wants a consumer-friendly phrasing.
prod-marketing: prefer short bullet at top for social: "CLI flag updates (model -> model-alias) + minor docs fixes." We also want the relnotes slug by 9am UTC tomorrow.
emma: target: finalize migrate-cli.md + relnotes draft by today 5pm PT. olga/raj: can you get PRs and reviewers by 3pm PT?
olga: will request an accelerated review.
docs-bot: PR #4010 merged by olga. PR #4011 awaiting review.
mike: telemetry/privacy note: ensure no example includes realistic session IDs or admin tokens. replace with placeholders like $ADMIN_TOKEN or REDWOOD_API_KEY env vars.
raj: agreed. i'll run a grep for patterns like rwd_[0-9]{6,} and for 40-char hex-looking tokens and open a scrub PR if needed.
emma: include a small section in relnotes called "Docs hygiene" listing checks we ran: anchor sweep, API key scrub, SDK version normalization, CLI example updates. keep it 3 bullets.
prod-marketing: copy polish offer: i can shape the top 3 bullets for public-facing copy once the draft lands.
emma: thanks. final: we'll publish relnotes with a link to migrate-cli.md and a short changelog entry in docs/changelog/2026-03.json. i'll ping here with the staging preview URL when available. last_message_ts=1767903600
